description:

Location: Leeds - Free Parking

Salary: £26k starting - rising to £28k

OTE: £55k - £60k uncapped

Info: Fantastic benefits, training, and career growth opportunities.

The Company

This business is simply the market leader and provider of technology-based communication and IT products and solutions to business clients in the UK.

A people and customer orientated business offering very strong career prospects, growth opportunities and a winning environment where effort and results are rewarded properly.

About the Role - Inside Sales Executive B2 B
- As a Sales Executive in this exciting role, you will contact a mixture of B2 B existing clients and new clients to advise them on the range of business-critical products on offer.
- Advising clients on retention, upgrades and additional communication led products and in addition working closely with the field sales team for larger clients.
- You will work towards achievable targets and can over-achieve to substantially increase your earnings with top performers earning well over £65k consistently.
- Your success will take place within a professional, long-established sales focussed market leader, enjoying all the latest and most advanced tools and support to help in your success.

About you - Inside Sales Executive B2 B
- We will consider all sales backgrounds for the role with particular interest in people who have a background in B2 B sales.
- Attitude, personality, ambition, and drive are key ingredients for this role.

- You are someone who wants to earn more than £50k and enjoys being a key part in an inclusive team who encourage each other towards their goals.

- Excellent starting basic salary which will be reviewed and increased quickly.

- Genuine opportunity to progress your career into more senior sales, field sales or management which is encouraged and supported from a business who prides itself on promotion from within.
- The backing and support of working with an amazing brand.
- Great benefits, incentives, social life, and culture are just some of the perks that you can expect.

title: Account Manager
description:
Sales Account Manager

Leeds City Centre

£30,000 Basic Salary + Uncapped Commission (£50,000 Year 1 OTE)

Are you a driven sales professional looking for your next challenge?

Whether you're a Business Development Executive, Sales Development Representative (SDR), Account Executive, Internal Sales Executive, or a Recruitment Consultant looking to move into a thriving technology-led business, this could be the perfect opportunity.

I'm looking for ambitious, commercially minded individuals who enjoy building relationships, uncovering customer needs, and closing opportunities. In return, you'll receive a £30,000 basic salary, uncapped commission with a realistic £50,000 first-year OTE, excellent training, and genuine career progression opportunities. Based on the role profile provided, you'll be responsible for both new business and account growth while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

The Opportunity

As a Sales Account Manager, you'll work with both new and existing business customers, helping them find the right solutions for their needs.

You'll take ownership of incoming enquiries, develop customer relationships, manage renewals, and identify opportunities to grow accounts.

This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys consultative sales, thrives on hitting targets, and wants to build a long-term career in a growing business.

What You'll Be Doing
- Speaking with customers to understand their requirements and recommend appropriate solutions.
- Managing inbound leads and proactively developing new business opportunities.
- Building and growing relationships with existing accounts.
- Conducting outbound calls to generate opportunities and drive revenue growth.
- Managing renewals and identifying upsell opportunities.
- Processing customer orders and ensuring a smooth customer journey.
- Maintaining an active sales pipeline and working towards individual and team targets.
- Working closely with internal teams to deliver outstanding customer service.

We're keen to speak with candidates from backgrounds including:
- Business Development Executive (BDE)
- Sales Development Representative (SDR)
- Account Executive
- Internal Sales Executive
- Telesales Executive
- Recruitment Consultant
- Customer-facing sales professionals looking for a consultative sales role

You'll likely have:
- A passion for sales and building relationships.
- Confidence speaking with customers over the phone.
- Strong communication and influencing skills.
- A target-driven mindset with a desire to earn commission.
- Resilience, determination, and a positive attitude.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.

What's On Offer?

£30,000 basic salary

Uncapped commission structure

Realistic Year 1 OTE of £50,000+

Full training and ongoing development

Clear career progression opportunities

Supportive and collaborative team environment

A chance to build a rewarding career in sales

If you're hungry to succeed, motivated by earning potential, and looking to join a business that invests in its people, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and take the next step in your sales career.

Guidant, Carbon 60, Lorien & SRG - The Impellam Group Portfolio are acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

title: IT Account Manager
description:
IT Account Manager

Paying between £ basic + Commission

Hybrid based (Leeds or Southampton)

Our client is a well-established technology solutions provider, delivering innovative connectivity, network security and voice services to businesses across the UK. As they continue to expand their customer base and service offering, they are seeking an experienced Account Manager to develop key client relationships and drive growth within existing accounts.

As Account Manager, you will act as the primary contact for a portfolio of existing customers, ensuring they receive an exceptional experience whilst identifying opportunities to introduce additional products and services.

You will work closely with customers to understand their strategic objectives, technology requirements and future plans, positioning the organisation as a trusted partner rather than simply a supplier.

Key Responsibilities:
- Manage and develop a portfolio of existing customer accounts.
- Build strong relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers.
- Conduct regular account reviews to understand customer requirements and future opportunities.
- Identify and deliver upsell and cross-sell opportunities across the full solutions portfolio, including connectivity, network security and voice services.
- Drive customer retention and maximise account value.
- Work collaboratively with technical, delivery and support teams to ensure excellent customer outcomes.
- Produce accurate forecasts, account plans and pipeline updates.
- Maintain a strong understanding of market trends and emerging technologies.

Required experience:
- Previous experience in an Account Manager, Client Manager or Business Development role.
- A track record of growing revenue within existing customer accounts.
- Experience selling technology, telecoms, IT, managed services, connectivity, security or communications solutions.
- Strong commercial acumen and a consultative approach to sales.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- The ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities effectively.
- A proactive and customer-centric mindset.

Must be eligible to work in the UK

Hybrid/Office based with occasional site visits (Hub can be either Leeds or Southampton)

Paying up to 45k basic + commission, depending on experience.
